verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships through plugin marketplaces: a Claude Code marketplace install (docs-36, docs-51), an Antigravity Marketplace manifest (docs-74) and `devin plugins install` (docs-7). The only explicitly documented update path, though, is for Antigravity: "Reinstall with the same command to update" (gh-8), which is a re-run of the install rather than a dedicated update command. Missing for 10: documented marketplace auto-update behavior, an explicit update command, update instructions for the other harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc.), and hands-on confirmation that updates apply in place without a fresh install.
